title: 3992. Rearrange String to Avoid Character Pair

examples.explanation: The string "cbaa" is a permutation of "aabc", and every occurrence of 'c' appears before every occurrence of 'a'.
The string "cabd" is a permutation of "dcab", and every occurrence of 'b' appears before every occurrence of 'd'.
The string "axe" is already valid. Since 'o' does not occur in the string, the required condition is automatically satisfied.

hints: Only the relative order between occurrences of x and y matters.
One approach is to place all occurrences of y before all other characters, and place all occurrences of x after them.

Another approach is to sort the characters of s. If x < y, sort in descending order; otherwise, sort in ascending order.

After sorting this way, every occurrence of y will appear before every occurrence of x.
